historical_executions.label: Hush EARS primary/background synthetic mixture screen
historical_executions.scope: Adjacent primary/background suppression only: EARS has no speaker metadata, the pairs are distinct recordings rather than verified distinct speakers, and the exact Hush API accepts no enrollment prompt. It raises the target/masker ratio while damaging the designated target, so it is not target-speaker extraction, not personalized VAD, not a physical-device or listening result, and not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Hush AMI speaker-dominant turn-mixture diagnostic
historical_executions.scope: Adjacent suppression diagnostic only: one AMI mono mix, seven constructed non-overlap directed pairs, no isolated references and no enrollment prompt. Positive ratio changes have intervals that include zero, so speaker separation is not established; not personalized VAD, not natural overlap, not a device result, and not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Seven-candidate held-out AMI any-speaker VAD comparison
historical_executions.scope: Any-speaker VAD baseline on three speaker-disjoint held-out AMI meetings projected onto 20 ms frames. These rows identify speech, not a selected speaker's activity, and contain no enrollment cue, target/other-speech class or impostor control. They are a comparator for a personal-VAD classifier that does not exist here, not personalized-VAD evidence, not a device or broad natural-call result, and not rerun by this survey.
